args.body:
Summary of websites shared in #general:

• www.informations.com — A news article covering the latest job report, which brought a mix of relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.

• www.restaurant-zurich.com — Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city, renowned for authentic Swiss cuisine. The menu features traditional dishes such as cheese fondue, hearty rösti, and chocolate fondue for dessert. Warm wooden interiors with Swiss memorabilia create a welcoming, rustic atmosphere, and large windows offer panoramic views of the city skyline. Friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire make each visit feel like a journey to the Swiss Alps.

Hi Dora! I visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice, clean introduction to you and it makes it easy to get in touch. A couple of suggestions if you'd like to make it more engaging: adding a short bio with a photo, some of your interests or recent work, and a few links to your other profiles would give visitors a much better sense of who you are. Overall, a solid starting point — keep it up!

Hi Eve! I visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com). It's a great home base for your writing, and I love that you share your passion for hiking — that's a wonderful theme to build a blog around. To make it even better, you could add some actual blog posts (with photos from your hikes), a short bio, and maybe a section for recent entries or an archive so readers can easily follow along. Looking forward to seeing more of your adventures!
